01 · Leadership Profile

I turn complex IT environments into clear decisions and resilient systems.

I work across technology strategy, enterprise architecture, governance, cybersecurity and execution. My role is to make the whole system visible, identify the real constraint, and create a practical route from ambiguity to action.

01 / Diagnose

See the real problem

Trace symptoms back to architecture, controls, ownership, dependencies and decision friction.

02 / Architect

Design the response

Translate strategy into systems, guardrails, recovery capability and practical implementation choices.

03 / Align

Connect the organisation

Bring leaders, technical teams, vendors and stakeholders into one coherent operating frame.

04 / Mobilise

Move into execution

Make ownership, sequence, risk, measures and next actions visible enough to sustain momentum.

02 · Expertise

Four disciplines. One leadership system.

The strongest technology environments are not built as isolated functions. Strategy, architecture, governance and resilience must reinforce one another.

Technology Strategy

Direction before investment

Align technology priorities, capability choices and investment decisions with organisational outcomes.

Enterprise Architecture

Coherence before complexity

Design connected, secure and scalable environments across infrastructure, applications, data and operations.

Governance & Cyber Risk

Confidence before exposure

Establish controls, compliance, accountability and security practices that leaders can understand and use.

Operational Resilience

Readiness before disruption

Strengthen continuity, disaster recovery and the ability to restore critical services under pressure.
